logline: Loss Aversion: You think a gain and a loss of equal size should weigh the same—but they never did. Backed by Daniel Kahneman & Amos Tversky (30 Decision Makers, 5 Studies).
director_vision: An intimate psychological thriller aesthetic in Cinematic 35mm Documentary (Humanized Portra 400). Grounding abstract decision theory in tangible physical textures, dramatic directional chiaroscuro, and purposeful camera choreography that mirrors the cognitive trap of Loss Aversion.
soundtrack_theme: Analog suspense score anchored at 45Hz sub-bass, Mid/Side vocal pocket ducking, and tactile physical Foley reflecting Loss Aversion.
